# Этап 2 — ход реализации

**Дата начала отчёта:** 23 октября 2026 года. Этап не принят; S2-00–14 приняты в указанных
границах, включая положительный physical slice S2-14.
ISSUE-011/012 остаются открытыми; наличие нового состояния или local instruction
slice не означает завершение этапа.

## Интеграция S2-30db и S2-37ds

В main интегрированы bounded `FSUBP ST(i),ST(0)` и masked-only memory
`MULPS XMM0,m128 [RAX]`. Совместный прогон прошёл: od-isa — 1,845; od-testkit
— 455; runner — 119 unit и 501 fixture; od-x86-runner — 8 library и 4 binary
tests; workspace all-target check, fmt, diff и layout. Graphify после обновления
кода содержит 11,480 nodes, 24,856 edges и 351 communities.

Независимые Sol/high reviews были чистыми. FSUBP сохраняет exact fallback,
проверяет округлённый physical pop state и odd 65-bit coefficient на 2,688
сочетаниях TOP/index/FCW/флагов. MULPS проверяет 1,792 oracle-комбинации
memory-векторов, включая NaN priority, same-lane denormal, zero×infinity,
underflow WPR midpoint, overflow и mixed sticky flags. Физическое x86
исполнение не проверялось. Завершённые worktree обоих срезов удалены после
переноса проверенных commit в main.

## S2-37dr — local-only Long64 legacy SUBPS m128 memory

Добавлен строгий schema-v2 профиль `s2-long-subps-memory-rax-v1` для точного
`0F 5C 00`: три байта полного fetch, один retire, stop RIP entry+3 и только
interpreter execution. Профиль требует SSE bit 25, CR0.EM=0, CR4.OSFXSR=1,
CR0.TS=0 и SSE state; полный fetch выполняется до #UD/#NM gates. MXCSR
ограничен поддержанным `0xffbf`, все шесть exception masks включены,
DAZ/FTZ/reserved bits выключены; все RC и прежние sticky values допускаются.

RAX обязан быть выровнен на 16 байт независимо от AC. Проверяются checked
canonical48 endpoints `[RAX,RAX+15]`, затем выполняется один `read16`.
Несовпадение gate/alignment/span и read fault не коммитят состояние.
Содержимое памяти вычитается из старого XMM0 по четырём binary32 lanes через
`Binary32::subtract_raw_result`; IE/DE/OE/UE/PE объединяются со sticky MXCSR,
а остальные регистры/flags сохраняются. Unmasked/#XM и JIT/native/C ABI/
generic/fragment остаются закрыты.

Fixture использует отдельные XMM0 и m128 lanes; schema validator сверяет
результат с независимым integer-only `independent_subps` oracle. Runner покрывает
четыре RC и 64 прежних sticky mask состояния, проверяет SSE gate и отказывает
в relabeling результата как JIT/NativeX86. Decoder и direct ISA проверки
подтверждают exact encoding, subtraction, отказ до data access для invalid
MXCSR/alignment/span и read16 rollback. Полные suites прошли: od-isa 1,840;
od-testkit 455; runner 119 unit + 498 fixture; x86-runner 8 library + 4 binary.
Workspace all-target offline check, fmt, diff check и Graphify refresh прошли
(11,488 nodes / 24,739 edges / 359 communities). Layout tool сообщает о
worktree `.git` marker и двух отсутствующих исторических oracle manifests,
ссылаемых из этого отчёта; новые пути не добавлялись. Independent Sol/high
review не нашёл production дефекта и запросил более широкие арифметические
векторы. Follow-up покрывает NaN payload/sign и SNaN-vs-QNaN priority,
denormal priority, opposite infinities, RC-sensitive tie и signed-zero, tiny
boundary, overflow и cross-lane IE/DE/OE/PE aggregation. Sequential fixture
rerun прошёл 498/498, включая расширенный SUBPS test; детали follow-up и
rationale для UE записаны в standalone report. No physical x86 acceptance is
claimed.

## S2-37dq — local-only Long64 legacy ADDPS m128 memory

Добавлен строгий schema-v2 профиль `s2-long-addps-memory-rax-v1` для точной
формы `ADDPS XMM0,m128 [RAX]` (`0F 58 00`, 3 байта). Он требует SSE bit 25,
декодирует весь код до проверки feature/#NM gates и не требует SSE2. Приняты
все режимы округления и прежние sticky flags при MXCSR с нулевыми reserved
bits, DAZ/FTZ=0 и всеми шестью mask bits=1. Каждый из четырёх little-endian
memory lanes складывается с соответствующим исходным lane XMM0 через
`Binary32::add_raw_result`; IE/DE/OE/UE/PE агрегируются по lanes и OR-ятся с
прежними flags, ZE и верхняя часть MXCSR сохраняются.

Операнд обязан быть выровнен на 16 байт при AC=0 и AC=1. Сначала проверяется
alignment, затем checked canonical48 span `[RAX,RAX+15]`; только после этого
выполняется ровно одно чтение 16 байт. Ошибка доступа или проверок сохраняет
CPU state, MXCSR, RIP и retirement. Writes отсутствуют. Strict result validator сверяет
вектор с независимым `independent_addps` oracle. Успешный результат нельзя
переименовать в JIT или NativeX86; оба backend также отказывают запуску
профиля. Decoder/register forms для остальных ADDPS не менялись.

Ручной fixture `s2_37dq_addps_m128_memory_source_and_destination_lanes.case.json`
содержит разные старые XMM0 и RHS lanes. Проверки включают все RC и sticky
combinations, ties, QNaN/SNaN operand order, signed zeros and cancellation,
mixed newly raised IE/DE/OE/PE with old UE/ZE stickies preserved, infinities,
subnormal и gates, полный fetch до отказа, exact/neighbor opcode, alignment,
canonical span, fault rollback, control/schema tampering и backend denial.
Independent Sol/high review выявил, что runtime MXCSR check был недостижим из-за
отсутствующего `AddpsMemoryRax` во внешнем operation allowlist; case добавлен,
а отрицательные MXCSR проверки подтверждают отказ до data read и commit.
Runner также проверяет NaN operand ordering, signed-zero/cancellation vectors,
output XMM/MXCSR/memory/control tampering и provenance validation. Повторный
Sol/high review подтвердил исправления и не нашёл оставшихся дефектов.

## S2-36ab — deterministic raw binary32 SSE reciprocal reference

`Binary32::reciprocal_sse_raw()` implements the local deterministic reference
policy: signed zero and signed subnormal inputs map to same-sign infinity;
infinity maps to same-sign zero; QNaN is unchanged and SNaN is quieted by
setting the quiet bit while preserving sign/payload. Normal finite input uses
the existing exact same-format `1.0 / source` divide path with fixed
nearest-ties-even rounding, then flushes any subnormal result to same-sign
zero. The API has no diagnostic outcome and does not mutate source, CPU state,
or MXCSR. It does not deliver SIMD FP exceptions or add instruction dispatch,
packed lanes, DAZ/FTZ framework, native, or JIT behavior.

The correctly rounded normal result is within relative error `2^-24`, safely
inside Intel's `1.5 * 2^-12` bound. Unit checks independently compare exact
integer significand products against `|x*y - 1| <= 3/8192`; flushed-zero
results are excluded. Literal coverage includes signed zeros, every subnormal
leading-bit position and sign, infinities, NaN sign/payload handling, exact
reciprocals, `1/3`, min-normal and output-boundary neighbors, max-finite input,
and source preservation. The test contains no host floating-point oracle.

**Checks:** `cargo test -p od-isa --offline
binary_float::tests::raw_sse_reciprocal` passed 2/2;
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests` passed 86/86;
`cargo check -p od-isa --all-targets --offline` passed;
`cargo fmt --all -- --check` passed after formatting; `git diff --check` passed;
`graphify update .` completed. Graphify retained its existing extractor warning
for `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h` (line 68), recorded as ISSUE-010.
Independent `gpt-6.1-sol` high review found that the integer-only product
checker needed an explicit sign equality assertion; the assertion was added,
the focused and full binary-float tests passed again, and re-review found no
remaining code or documentation findings. The reviewer independently fetched
the official Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B PDF and confirmed the overlapping
RCPPS pp. 4-538–4-539 and RCPSS pp. 4-540–4-541 threshold inequalities recorded
for ISSUE-025.

The local reference policy does not claim bitwise hardware equivalence. Intel
SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B RCPPS pp. 4-538–4-539 and RCPSS pp. 4-540–4-541 specify
the approximation bound and special/denormal behavior, but the published
threshold inequalities overlap contradictorily. This ambiguity and its
hardware-validation next step are recorded in
[ISSUE-025](../KNOWN_ISSUES.md#issue-025--intel-rcpssrcpps-threshold-inequalities-overlap).
Final Mac mini hardware acceptance is to validate the `3/8192` relative-error
envelope for non-flushed normal outputs, without requiring exact equality to
the helper's result bits. The ambiguous tiny-result boundary remains a
separate unresolved hardware question.

## S2-36ac — deterministic raw binary32 SSE reciprocal-square-root reference

`Binary32::reciprocal_sqrt_sse_raw()` implements a pure deterministic value
reference. Signed zeros and either-sign subnormals map to same-sign infinity;
negative normals and negative infinity map to negative indefinite QNaN;
positive infinity maps to positive zero, inferred from `1/sqrt(x)`. QNaN is
preserved and SNaN is quieted by setting its quiet bit while preserving sign
and payload as a local policy. Positive normal inputs compose the existing
nearest-ties-even `sqrt_raw_result` followed by `reciprocal_sse_raw` on its
value. This method takes no rounding argument, returns no diagnostics, and
does not mutate CPU/MXCSR state or deliver SIMD FP exceptions.

The composed result is a deterministic reference, not an exact or
hardware-matching bit claim. Each RNE stage has relative error at most
`u=2^-24`; the composition is bounded by `2u/(1-u) < 1.5 * 2^-12`. Its
independent test checks the exact 24-bit significand/exponent inequality by
u128 cross-multiplication, with no host floating-point or production-helper
oracle. Literal coverage includes `1→1`, `4→0.5`, `16→0.25`, `0.25→2`,
`2^-126→2^63`, signed zeros, all subnormal leading-bit positions and signs,
infinities, negative normals, varied QNaN/SNaN payloads, source immutability,
and representative significands across every normal exponent.

Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B `RSQRTPS` pp. 4-594–4-595 and `RSQRTSS` pp.
4-596–4-597 specify the special-class behavior, no SIMD FP exceptions,
independence from MXCSR.RC, and the `1.5 * 2^-12` relative-error limit.
Positive-infinity mapping and NaN sign/payload details follow the explicit
local policy where the operation text does not fully specify them. [Official
Intel Vol. 2B PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241). Packed
lanes, instruction dispatch, MXCSR state, native/JIT, CPUID, and physical
hardware validation remain outside this slice.

**Checks:** focused rsqrt tests passed (2/2); the complete `od-isa`
`binary_float::tests` suite passed (88/88), including existing square-root
and reciprocal helper regressions. Reproduce with:

```sh
cargo test -p od-isa --offline raw_sse_reciprocal_sqrt
cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests
cargo fmt --all -- --check
cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline
```

`graphify update .` updated the code graph. Independent `gpt-6.1-sol` medium
code and documentation reviews reported no findings.

## S2-37a — local-only Long64 legacy register RSQRTSS

Added schema-v2 profile `s2-long-rsqrtss-reg-v1` for the exact register
encoding `F3 [one adjacent REX.R/B] 0F 52 /r`, ModR/M.mod=3, XMM0–15. The
decoder rejects memory operands, other legacy prefixes, REX.W/X, duplicate or
nonadjacent REX, truncation, VEX/EVEX, and opcode neighbors. Interpreter
execution invokes only `Binary32::reciprocal_sqrt_sse_raw()` on the source low
dword and writes only the destination low dword. The upper 96 destination bits,
all other XMM/GPR/x87 state, RFLAGS, and MXCSR remain unchanged. The focused
execution matrix covers all 256 source/destination register pairs including
aliases, representative special inputs, and confirms zero data-memory
callbacks. A schema-v2 fixture runs `RSQRTSS XMM8,XMM9` with `4.0` producing the
local reference value `0.5`.

The profile assumes SSE and CR0/CR4 permission. Generic CPUID, #UD/#NM,
MXCSR state/exceptions, and guest FP flags are not implemented. The local
approximation is not asserted to match hardware bits; JIT and native admission
are explicitly denied. Physical/hardware envelope validation remains deferred
to the combined final Mac mini substage, so this result establishes local
semantic coverage only.

passed (1 test); `cargo fmt --all -- --check`,
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, and `git diff --check`

## S2-36a — raw binary32/binary64 classification and finite normalization

**Статус:** source implementation and focused tests are complete; workspace
check, formatting, and independent Sol medium code review passed clean, with no
findings remaining.
The public immutable `Binary32` and `Binary64` wrappers preserve raw encodings
and expose `from_bits`, `to_bits`, sign, biased exponent, fraction, class, and
`normalize_finite`.
`BinaryClass` has the six classes Zero, Subnormal, Normal, Infinity, QuietNaN,
and SignalingNaN. `normalize_finite() -> Option<BinaryFinite>` is integer-only,
retains source class and signed zero, represents every nonzero finite value
exactly as `(-1)^sign × significand × 2^(exponent−63)` with bit 63 set, and
returns `None` for infinity and NaNs. The normalized view exposes sign,
significand, exponent and source class. No host `f32`/`f64` arithmetic or
rounding is used; classification preserves signaling NaNs without quieting
them. Raw-wrapper equality is bit identity, not guest floating-point equality.

This slice establishes only raw encoding classification and an exact finite

## S2-36b — exact finite significand multiplication

**Статус:** bounded mathematical helper and focused tests are implemented;
independent Sol medium code review completed clean, with no findings remaining. The public
`multiply_finite_significands(lhs: BinaryFinite, rhs: BinaryFinite) ->
(bool, i32, u128)` returns `(sign, exponent, magnitude)` for nonzero finite
inputs. It computes sign XOR, exponent sum plus one, and the full unsigned
128-bit product, representing the exact result as
`(-1)^sign × magnitude × 2^(exponent−127)`. It does not shift, truncate,
round, or pack. If either operand is zero, the helper returns `(false, 0, 0)`
as a signless mathematical sentinel, not as an architectural positive-zero
decision. The helper does not mutate CPU state or x87 state.

**Literal boundary results:**

| Inputs | Tuple `(sign, exponent, magnitude)` |
|---|---|
| `1 × 1` | `(false, 1, 0x40000000000000000000000000000000)` |
| `1.5 × 1.5` | `(false, 1, 0x90000000000000000000000000000000)` |
| Binary32 successor of 1 squared | `(false, 1, 0x40000100000100000000000000000000)` |
| Binary64 successor of 1 squared | `(false, 1, 0x40000000000008000000000000400000)` |
| Minimum binary32 subnormal squared | `(false, -297, 0x40000000000000000000000000000000)` |
| Minimum binary64 subnormal squared | `(false, -2147, 0x40000000000000000000000000000000)` |
| Maximum binary32 finite squared | `(false, 255, 0xfffffe00000100000000000000000000)` |
| Maximum binary64 finite squared | `(false, 2047, 0xfffffffffffff0000000000000400000)` |

The successor-of-one literals retain low product bits that rounding or early
truncation would lose. The tests also cover all four nonzero sign combinations,
both signed-zero operand positions and zero×zero, mixed binary32/binary64
inputs, and normal/subnormal combinations. Input exponents bound the returned
exponent to −2147…2047; normalized 64-bit significands fit their exact product
in `u128`.

(6/6); `cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`;
`git diff --check`; and `graphify update .` passed. Graphify emitted the
pre-existing syntax-extractor warning for `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h`
and exited successfully. Independent Sol review reran
`cargo test -p od-isa binary_float --offline` (6/6) and found no issues. This
is a mathematical helper only: no guest FP instruction, rounding/exception
semantics, physical check, or x87 change is claimed. S2-36 rounding/exceptions
and S2-37/S2-38 remain open. Normative
context is Intel SDM Vol. 1 Rev. 093, §§4.8.2, 4.2.2/Table 4-3, 4.8.4, and
4.8.3.1 ([official Intel PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/929351)).

## S2-36d — shared exact rational precision rounding

**Статус:** implementation and author checks are complete; independent Sol
medium code review completed clean, with no findings. The private
`rational_rounding` module now owns
`RationalRoundingMode` and the shared rounding implementation. The enum is
re-exported through `binary_float` and `x87`. The new public binary helper is
`round_quotient_to_precision(sign, q, r, d, precision, mode) ->
Option<(u128, bool)>`; its tuple is unsigned rounded magnitude and `inexact`.
The existing public x87 helper retains its signature and result type, delegates
to the shared implementation, and discards `inexact`.

The helper rounds the exact coefficient `(-1)^sign * (q + r/d)` to precision
1…64 using nearest ties to even, toward zero, toward positive, or toward
negative. It combines discarded `q` bits with the exact `r/d` tail, so nearest
ties and directed increments use the full exact remainder. `inexact` is true
when either discarded `q` bits or `r` are nonzero. A rounding carry is
preserved as magnitude `2^precision`; the helper does not adjust an exponent,
pack a binary32/binary64 result, or update status. A zero coefficient returns
unsigned magnitude 0 and `inexact=false`, without selecting a guest zero sign.
If `k = 64 - precision`, the rounded coefficient represented by the returned
magnitude is `magnitude * 2^k`. When composed with an S2-36c quotient at
exponent `e`, the represented value is
`(-1)^sign * magnitude * 2^(e + 1 - precision)`.

Inputs are rejected with `None` when precision is outside 1…64, `d == 0`,
`r >= d`, `q` is nonzero but below `2^63`, or `q == 0 && r != 0`. No floating
point exceptions, architectural status flags, instruction execution, or x87
API/behavior changes are claimed.

`r >= d`, unnormalized nonzero `q`, and a zero `q` with nonzero `r`. A
binary32/64 division composition test checks the helper at precisions 24, 53,
and 64. The author reports both focused test commands passed without warnings.

## S2-36f — direct exact quotient rounding to subnormal units

**Статус:** implementation and author checks are complete; independent Sol
medium code review completed clean, with no findings. The public
`Binary32::round_pack_subnormal_quotient(sign, exponent, quotient, remainder,
denominator, mode)` and `Binary64` counterpart return `Option<(Self, bool)>`:
the raw result and an `inexact` indication. They round directly from the
original S2-36c quotient, remainder, denominator, and exponent into units of
the format's least subnormal. They do not round to normal precision first and
then shift; that sequence can double-round near the largest-subnormal/minimum-
normal boundary.

For exponent `e` and subnormal-unit exponent `L`, the helper computes widened
`k = 63 + L - e`. Binary32 uses `L = -149`, precision 24, and `emin = -126`;
binary64 uses `L = -1074`, precision 53, and `emin = -1022`. For `k <= 63`, it
uses the shared S2-36d precision rounder on the original `q/r/d` with precision
`64-k`. At `k == 64`, it compares the original value to the half-unit boundary;
for `k > 64`, nearest/toward-zero yield zero while directed modes can yield one
subnormal unit as required by sign. Both `k >= 64` branches are inexact for
every admitted nonzero quotient; `k <= 63` uses S2-36d's exact inexactness
result. The output keeps the input sign even when a nonzero value rounds to
zero. The only status returned is `inexact`.

The helper rejects exact zero or a non-normalized quotient, zero denominator,
`remainder >= denominator`, and exponents at or above `emin`. It returns
`None` for inputs outside this subnormal-rounding helper's domain; it does not
signal an architectural fault. No underflow flag, MXCSR update, exception,
zero-input handling, or x87 change is included.

Source tests cover exact minimum subnormal, half-minimum-subnormal ties and
rational tails, all directed modes for both signs at half and far-below cases,
`k == 64` and `k > 64`, largest-subnormal/minimum-normal boundaries, signed
zero from nonzero underflow, invalid input rejection, `i32::MIN` exponent
safety, and composition from exact division results with input immutability.

## S2-36j — finite binary addition composition

**Статус:** bounded finite-addition composition and author checks are complete;
independent Sol medium code review completed clean, with no findings. Public
`Binary32::add_finite_aligned(lhs, rhs, mode)` and
`Binary64::add_finite_aligned(...)` return `Option<(Self, bool)>`, containing a
destination encoding and final mathematical `inexact`. The bounded alignment
accepts exponent gaps through 64; wider gaps return `None`. A single zero
operand acts as the identity and returns the other value rounded to the
destination format. Both-zero and exact-cancellation sums return `None`, so
this helper does not choose a guest zero sign. Overflow rejection also returns
`None`; no guest exception, flags, or NaN/infinity policy are defined.

For two nonzero values, the implementation aligns unsigned significands at the
smaller exponent in `u128`, adds magnitudes for equal signs, and subtracts the
smaller magnitude from the larger for opposite signs. The exact aligned result
is `(-1)^sign * magnitude * 2^(exponent-63)`. A private normalized-sum bridge
shifts the exact magnitude to bit 127 and adjusts its exponent without losing
bits. Normalized binary32 and binary64 significands each have at least 11 low
zero bits; alignment and sum/difference preserve this divisibility, making the
normalized magnitude even. The bridge therefore decomposes exactly into
`q=(N>>64)`, `r=(N low64)>>1`, and `d=2^63`, representing
`(-1)^sign * (q + r/d) * 2^(e-63)`. This is a format-specific bridge, not a
generic integer conversion.

Destination format selects p=24/emin=-126 for binary32 or p=53/emin=-1022 for
binary64, including with mixed inputs. Normal results go through one S2-36d
round and S2-36e pack; subnormal results round the original exact bridge
directly through S2-36f. This avoids intermediate rounding and normal-then-
subnormal double rounding. A nonzero exact sum rounded to zero retains its sum
sign. The boolean reports only mathematical `inexact`; no status flags or
exception delivery are added, and x87 is unchanged.

Tests cover same-sign addition, opposite-sign differences, deep cancellation
`successor(1)+(-1)=+2^-52` and `(-successor(1))+1=-2^-52`, exact
minimum-subnormal results, the gap-64 acceptance/gap-65
rejection boundary, signed-zero identity, mixed-format inputs, and input
immutability. A normal double-round regression for
`0x3ff0_0000_0000_0001 + 0x3c9f_ffff_ffff_ffff` yields
`0x3ff0_0000_0000_0001` with `inexact=true`; a binary64-to-binary32 subnormal
regression yields `0x007f_ffff` with `inexact=true` by rounding directly.

wrapper toggles the sign in a copy of the right `BinaryFinite` and delegates
to S2-36j addition. Thus it uses the same gap limit (at most 64), exact
alignment bridge, destination-selected precision, and single normal rounding
or direct subnormal rounding. Overflow returns `None`. No guest exception,
status flag, or x87 behavior is added.

Exact cancellation and both-zero inputs return `None` in every mode, deferring
the guest signed-zero rule. With one zero operand, `x-0` returns `x`, while
`0-x` returns the sign-negated `x`, rounded to the destination format. A
nonzero exact difference that rounds to zero preserves its difference sign;
the boolean is mathematical `inexact` only.

Tests cover binary32/binary64 `1.5-1` and `1-1.5`, successor-of-one deep
cancellation, minimum-normal minus maximum-subnormal yielding minimum
subnormal, exact-zero and both-zero rejection in all four modes, zero
identity/negation, tiny signed results in all four modes, mixed-format
operands, gap 64 acceptance and gap 65 rejection in both orders, overflow
rejection, and input immutability. A normal double-round regression computes
`0x3ff0_0000_0000_0001 - 0xbc9f_ffff_ffff_ffff` and expects binary64
`0x3ff0_0000_0000_0001` with `inexact=true`. A subnormal double-round
regression computes binary64 `0x3810_0000_0000_0000 -
0x3690_0000_0000_0001` into binary32 and expects largest subnormal
`0x007f_ffff` with `inexact=true` via the direct subnormal path.
Across all four modes, equal positive and equal negative nonzero inputs return
`None` for both binary32 and binary64 sources and destinations; the binary64
signed-zero pair matrix also returns `None`.

## S2-36l — finite binary comparison

**Статус:** finite comparison helper and author checks are complete;
independent Sol medium code review completed clean, with no findings. Public
`compare_finite(lhs: BinaryFinite, rhs: BinaryFinite) ->
core::cmp::Ordering` compares finite normalized values numerically. Signed
zeros compare Equal, while `Binary32`/`Binary64` raw-bit `Eq` remains unchanged
and still distinguishes the two zero encodings. For nonzero values, compare
sign first; for matching signs, compare normalized `(exponent, significand)`
lexicographically and reverse the magnitude order when both values are
negative. The helper performs no host floating-point operations and adds no
wrapper `Eq`/`Ord` implementation.

largest-subnormal/minimum-normal and minimum-subnormal/maximum-finite
boundaries, and exact mixed-format equality for 1, minimum subnormal, and
minimum normal. Mixed precision ordering, reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity,
source-class retention, and input immutability are also covered.

## S2-36m — finite binary multiplication output and rounding diagnostics

**Статус:** математический finite round/pack и multiplication result helper
реализованы; локальные проверки и независимые code/docs review завершены.
Полная приёмка S2-36 и hardware validation остаются открытыми. Этот
substage расширяет finite multiplication composition до полного результата в
формате назначения и диагностик `BinaryRoundingResult`. Для ненулевого точного
результата `tiny` определяется после округления до точности формата назначения
с неограниченным exponent: он истинен тогда и только тогда, когда модуль этого
округлённого значения меньше минимального normal. `overflow` истинен только
когда модуль этого округлённого значения с неограниченным exponent больше
максимального finite. Знак сохраняется при выборе итогового ограниченного
результата по режиму округления, а `inexact` описывает точность финального
результата. Если результат после округления до точности формата с неограниченным
exponent tiny, исходное точное рациональное значение округляется напрямую в
единицах subnormal; итогом может быть zero, subnormal или minimum normal.
Промежуточного normal-rounding нет.
При точном нуле умножения знак результата равен XOR знаков операндов.

Контракт ограничен локальной математикой finite multiplication. Он не добавляет
architectural SSE/x87 flags, MXCSR, DAZ/FTZ, операции над NaN/Infinity, полные
сложение/вычитание, instruction dispatch или приёмку всего S2-36. Проверки
подтверждают локальный контракт, но не аппаратное поведение или acceptance
всего этапа.

binary_float::tests` (38/38), `cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests`
(47/47), `cargo fmt --all -- --check`,
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, `git diff --check` и
`graphify update .`. Graphify сообщил существующее предупреждение парсера для
`include/open_desktop/host_abi.h`, завершившись с кодом 0. Независимое ревью
кода Sol medium и документации завершилось без замечаний.

Нормативный контекст терминов и границ формата: Intel SDM Vol. 1, Order
253665-093US (September 2026), §§4.9.1.4–4.9.1.6, Tables 4-10–4-12
([официальный Intel PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436)).
Эта ссылка не задаёт взаимно-однозначное соответствие локальных диагностик
архитектурным exception flags. Приёмочные критерии S2-36 остаются открытыми.

## S2-36n — finite binary division output and rounding diagnostics

**Статус:** finite division result helper реализован; локальные проверки и
независимые code/docs review завершены. Полная приёмка S2-36 и hardware
validation остаются открытыми.

Finite binary division дополнено полным результатом в формате назначения и
диагностикой `BinaryRoundingResult`, используя
`divide_finite_significands` для точного quotient и round/pack контракт
S2-36m для ограниченного результата. Существующая сигнатура и совместимое
поведение `divide_finite`, включая обработку нулевых операндов, сохранены.
Новый complete-result helper возвращает `None` только при
нулевом делителе; это локальный математический контракт, а не архитектурная
доставка `#Z`.
При нулевом числителе и ненулевом делителе точный zero со знаком XOR
возвращается до exact helper, поскольку его zero sentinel не содержит знак.

Для ненулевых операндов точный quotient формируется один раз. Выбор normal,
subnormal или overflow пути выполняется по исходному quotient, без
промежуточного округления. Итоговое ограниченное значение и диагностики
`tiny`/`overflow`/`inexact` соответствуют S2-36m. В новом
complete-result helper `None` применяется только для нулевого делителя;
overflow выражается ограниченным результатом и диагностикой, а не отказом.
Legacy `divide_finite` сохраняет прежний тип результата и обработку нулевых
операндов.

Вне объёма остаются NaN/infinity, архитектурная доставка `#Z`, MXCSR/x87
flags, DAZ/FTZ, instruction integration и полная приёмка S2-36. Добавленные
проверки покрывают signed zero numerator, zero divisor, точные и неточные
normal результаты, прямое округление у subnormal boundary,
rounding-mode-dependent overflow results/diagnostics, смешанные форматы и
неизменность входов. Они проверяют использование исходного точного quotient
для subnormal/overflow решений и однократное вычисление quotient.

## S2-36o — finite binary addition and subtraction output in the gap-64 profile

**Статус:** локальные finite add/sub result API реализованы и проверены для
профиля exponent gap ≤64. Независимые code/docs review завершены. Полная
приёмка S2-36 и hardware acceptance остаются открытыми.

Добавлены для `Binary32`/`Binary64` новые
`add_finite_aligned_result` и `subtract_finite_aligned_result`, возвращающие
`Option<BinaryRoundingResult<Self>>`; существующие bounded API сохранены без
изменения контрактов. Bounded профиль охватывает конечные
нормализованные операнды с exponent gap до 64 включительно. `None` возвращается
для ненулевого gap больше 64; более широкий gap остаётся ограничением профиля
и не закрыт этой задачей. Для gap до 64 новые результаты совпадают с legacy
helper-ами там, где те возвращают `Some`; signed-zero и overflow outputs
дополняют случаи, где прежние helper-ы возвращали `None`.

Exact alignment использует `u128` и сохраняет разряды при gap≤64 до одного
округления. `tiny`/`overflow`/`inexact` и итоговое bounded значение следуют
S2-36m, без intermediate rounding. Знак exact zero учитывает операцию:
для сложения одинаковые знаки нулей сохраняются, а opposing exact terms и
ненулевое точное cancellation дают `-0` только при `TowardNegative`; вычитание
следует точной сумме `lhs + (-rhs)`. Вычитание одного нуля из ненулевого `lhs`
сохраняет знак `lhs`, а комбинации нулей следуют знакам эффективных слагаемых
и направлению округления. Ненулевой точный результат, округлившийся в ноль,
сохраняет свой знак. Literal-векторы проверяют эти случаи, включая все режимы,
two-nonzero cancellation, overflow, signed-zero rounding, gap64/65 и прямой
subnormal boundary без double rounding.

Нормативный контекст для локальной политики exact-zero signs: Intel SDM Rev.
093, [Vol. 1 PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436) и
[Vol. 2A PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199). Они служат
основанием для политики знака локального математического результата; это не
утверждение об интеграции SSE/x87 инструкций и не hardware evidence.

## S2-36p — finite binary addition and subtraction result APIs across the full finite exponent range

**Статус:** реализовано для новых finite add/sub result APIs `Binary32` и
`Binary64` во всём конечном диапазоне exponent gaps. Low-level exact-alignment
helpers и legacy APIs по-прежнему намеренно ограничены gap≤64; их контракты и
поведение не менялись. [ISSUE-024](../KNOWN_ISSUES.md#issue-024--s2-36-result-apis-lacked-large-gap-rounding)
закрыта для полного result path. Полная арифметическая приёмка S2-36 и
аппаратная проверка остаются открытыми.

Реализация расширила только новые `add_finite_aligned_result` и
`subtract_finite_aligned_result` у `Binary32`/`Binary64` на весь конечный
диапазон exponent gaps для поддерживаемых пар форматов. Low-level exact
alignment и legacy APIs сохраняют gap≤64 и свои сигнатуры/поведение.

При gap `d≥65`, старшем нормализованном significand `a`, младшем `b` и
показателе старшего операнда `e`, private tail bridge получает
`(Q+T)·2^(E-63)`. После преобразования subtraction к effective terms
(rhs меняет знак в копии), одинаковые знаки дают `Q=a`, `T=b/2^d`, `E=e`;
разные знаки означают вычитание меньшей величины из большей: при `a>2^63`
`Q=a-1`, `T=1-b/2^d`, `E=e`; при `a=2^63` — `Q=u64::MAX`,
`T=1-b/2^(d-1)`, `E=e-1`. Для `a,b∈[2^63,2^64)` и `d≥65` первый
дробный член `b/2^d` лежит в `(0,1/2)`, во втором случае
`T=1-b/2^d` лежит в `(1/2,1)`, а `b/2^(d-1)` — в `(0,1)`. Значит,
в каждом случае `0<T<1`, `Q` нормализовано и большого
gap недостаточно для cancellation.

Хвост проходит через приватный round-equivalent bridge для destination
precision 24/53. Представитель `r=1,d=4` (1/4) не является точным quotient;
он сохраняет round/pack решения и diagnostics S2-36m: integer low bits задают
сторону midpoint, ненулевой tail отличает tie от значения по другую сторону,
а subnormal cases `k=64` и `k>64` используют только релевантные признаки
ненулевого остатка. Это не общий precision-64 bridge. При gap≤64 остаётся
прежний точный `u128` путь. Flags, exception delivery, DAZ/FTZ, NaN/infinity
и instruction integration не входят в задачу.

Literal-векторы покрывают все rounding modes, оба знака и операции, gap
64/65/2097, significands `2^63`/`2^63+1`, midpoint sides, normal/subnormal
и overflow boundaries, итоговые bits и diagnostics. Проверки автора прошли:
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests` (48/48),
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests` (47/47),
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
`git diff --check` и `graphify update .` (успех; существующее предупреждение
парсера `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h`). Независимые code review Sol medium
и documentation review завершились без замечаний. Hardware/SSH regression
отложена до общего финального substage; аппаратная проверка и полная S2-36
приёмка не заявляются.
Форматный finite exponent context binary32/binary64: Intel SDM Rev. 093,
Vol. 1 [official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436).
Формулы `Q/T/E` и их доказательство относятся к математике локального API,
а не к реализации или аппаратной проверке инструкций.

Методы принимают raw операнды одного формата и возвращают отдельный
`BinaryDivisionResult<Self>` с result encoding, S2-36n diagnostics, local
`invalid_operation` и local `divide_by_zero`. Для этого division outcome не
добавлен к общему arithmetic result. API не изменяет MXCSR/x87 state, не
выбирает masking и не выполняет exception delivery.

NaN обработка идёт первой и использует shared resolver S2-36q/r: выбранный
первый source QNaN сохраняется, выбранный SNaN quiet-ится сохранением sign и
payload, любой SNaN ставит invalid. NaN над нулевым знаменателем не сообщает
divide-by-zero. `0/0` и `∞/∞` возвращают negative Intel indefinite QNaN
(`0xffc00000` для binary32, `0xfff8000000000000` для binary64) с invalid.
Finite nonzero/±0 возвращает infinity с XOR sign и только
`divide_by_zero=true`; `∞/0` возвращает тот же знаковый infinity без
divide-by-zero. Ноль/конечное ненулевое и finite/infinity дают zero с XOR sign;
infinity/finite nonzero даёт infinity с XOR sign. Все эти special results имеют
false `inexact`, `overflow` и `tiny_after_precision_rounding`.

Raw finite/finite pairs, включая zero numerator и ненулевой denominator,
нормализуются и делегируют `divide_finite_result`, сохраняя single rounding и
S2-36n diagnostics. Literal cases проверяют обе ширины, special class matrix,
NaN versus zero, source order/sign/payload, signs и operand order, отсутствие
ложного divzero, all-mode signed zero, а также finite exact/inexact/subnormal/
underflow/overflow outputs. Пройдены `cargo test -p od-isa --offline
binary_float::tests` (60/60), `cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests`
(47/47), fmt, workspace check, diff check и `graphify update .`. Independent Sol
medium code review и docs review завершились без замечаний.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093, Vol. 1 §4.9.1.3 (`#Z` is raised only for
finite nonzero / zero), §4.9.2 (QNaN takes precedence over divide-by-zero),
§4.8.3.7 / Table D-1 (negative indefinite QNaN values;
[official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436)). Эти ссылки
обосновывают local raw result contract, не exception flags/delivery.
См. [план S2-36s](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36s--raw-same-format-binary32binary64-division).

## S2-36t — raw same-format binary32/binary64 comparison

**Статус:** `Binary32::compare_raw` / `Binary64::compare_raw` реализованы.
Локальные авторские проверки прошли; independent Sol medium code review и docs
review завершились без замечаний. Полная S2-36 и hardware/Mac mini acceptance
остаются открытыми.

Методы принимают два same-format raw operands и явный
`BinaryComparisonMode::{Quiet, Signaling}`, возвращая
`BinaryComparisonResult` с relation `Less`, `Equal`, `Greater` или `Unordered`
и local `invalid_operation`. Любой NaN возвращает Unordered без изменения
операндов: Quiet ставит invalid только для SNaN; Signaling — для QNaN и SNaN.
Это не arithmetic first-source NaN propagation. Нормальные конечные значения,
нули и subnormals delegate to `compare_finite`; signed zero численно равен,
хотя raw `Eq` остаётся bitwise. Бесконечности сравниваются в обычном
численном порядке. Новые API не добавляют EFLAGS/MXCSR/x87 state, exception
delivery или `PartialOrd`/`Ord`.

Literal vectors для обеих ширин проверяют NaN source position/type по обоим
режимам, обе NaNs, неизменность raw bits, signed infinity/zero behavior,
subnormal/normal and adjacent-normal boundaries, exact equality и reversal
отношений. Пройдены `cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests`
(64/64), `cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests` (47/47),
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
`git diff --check` и `graphify update .`. Независимые Sol medium code review и
docs review завершились без замечаний; hardware/SSH проверка отложена до общего
финального substage. S2-36 не заявляется завершённой.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093, Vol. 2A COMISD/UCOMISD §3-199 and
COMISS/UCOMISS §3-201 ([official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199)).
Для этих compare families NaN relationship is unordered; COMI raises invalid
for QNaN/SNaN while UCOMI raises invalid for SNaN. This API models relation and
local invalid only, not architectural status/EFLAGS or delivery. See [plan
S2-36t](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36t--raw-same-format-binary32binary64-comparison).

## S2-36u — raw binary32-to-binary64 widening

**Статус:** `Binary64::widen_from_binary32` добавлен; авторские локальные
проверки и независимые Sol medium code/docs reviews завершились без замечаний.
Полная S2-36 и hardware/Mac mini acceptance остаются открытыми.

Метод расширяет raw `Binary32` в `BinaryArithmeticResult<Binary64>` без
rounding mode и host floating-point. Знак нуля сохраняется; конечные normal и
subnormal values преобразуются точно, причём все binary32 subnormals становятся
normal binary64. Infinity сохраняет знак. NaN payload размещается в верхних
23 битах binary64 fraction с сохранением знака. SNaN quiet-ится в выходе и
возвращает локальный `invalid_operation=true`; QNaN оставляет его false. Все
rounding diagnostics ложны, вход не меняется, CPU/MXCSR state и denormal input
exception delivery вне этого value-only API.

Литеральные векторы включают оба знака нуля и конечных значений, minnormal,
adjacent normal, maxfinite, все 23 позиции старшего set bit subnormal,
infinity, несколько QNaN/SNaN payload patterns и неизменность source.
Пройдены `cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests` (67/67),
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests` (47/47), `cargo fmt --all -- --check`,
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, `git diff --check` и
`graphify update .`. Graphify успешно обновил граф и вывел существующие
предупреждения для `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h` и файлов без символов;
это не блокировало обновление. Независимые Sol medium code/docs reviews
завершились без замечаний; Mac mini/SSH acceptance не выполнялись и отложены до
общего финального substage.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 1 Table D-11 задаёт binary32→binary64 NaN
sign, exponent, payload extension и quieting SNaN; CVTSS2SD Vol. 2A §3-240
указана лишь как будущий consumer. См. [Vol. 1](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436)
и [Vol. 2A](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199). Это основание

См. [план S2-36u](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36u--raw-binary32-to-binary64-widening).

## S2-36v — raw binary64-to-binary32 narrowing

`Binary32::narrow_from_binary64(source, mode)` returns
`BinaryArithmeticResult<Binary32>` and accepts an explicit
`RationalRoundingMode`. Signed zero and signed infinity retain their signs.
Finite nonzero values are normalized exactly and rounded once directly through
the existing binary32 precision/range round-and-pack helper. Its final
conversion diagnostics report inexactness, overflow, and tininess after
precision rounding. No host floating point, intermediate binary32 operation,
CPU/MXCSR update, DAZ/FTZ, instruction dispatch, or architectural exception
delivery is modeled.

NaNs retain sign and the most significant 23 source fraction bits. QNaN has no
invalid outcome; SNaN sets the destination quiet bit and reports local
`invalid_operation=true`. All NaN rounding diagnostics are false. Literal
tests include signed zeros/infinities, payload truncation boundaries (including
SNaNs whose retained payload becomes zero), exact finite values, ties for both
signs under all four modes, half-minimum-subnormal/tininess behavior, and
positive/negative overflow results under every mode. The matrix also covers
binary64 minimum and maximum subnormal inputs and the binary32 largest-subnormal
/ minimum-normal midpoint for both signs, including tininess-after-precision
diagnostics.

Авторские проверки прошли: `cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests`
(70/70), `cargo test -p od-isa --offline x87::tests` (47/47),
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
`git diff --check` и `graphify update .`. Graphify обновил граф с 7922 nodes и
15919 edges; вывел уже известное syntax warning для
`include/open_desktop/host_abi.h`, предупреждения о файлах без symbols и
уведомление о необходимости обновить названия communities. Независимые Sol
medium code/docs reviews завершились без замечаний. Hardware/Mac mini проверка
отложена до общего финального substage; S2-36 остаётся открытой.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 1 Table D-12 задаёт truncation low 29
binary64 fraction bits и quieting SNaN; Vol. 2A `CVTSD2SS` §3-234–235 задаёт
rounding control для double-to-single conversion. См. [Vol. 1](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/929351)
и [Vol. 2A](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199). Они обосновывают
raw conversion contract, не admission инструкции или hardware evidence. См.
[план S2-36v](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36v--raw-binary64-to-binary32-narrowing).

## S2-36w — bounded signed i64-to-binary32/binary64 conversion

`Binary32::from_i64(value, mode)` and `Binary64::from_i64(value, mode)` now
provide value-only conversions with an explicit `RationalRoundingMode`. A
shared integer-only normalizer forms sign, `floor(log2(abs(value)))`, and a
normalized u64 significand; `i64::unsigned_abs()` handles `i64::MIN` without
signed overflow. Zero returns positive zero. Each nonzero conversion calls
only its destination format's existing `round_pack_quotient` once with the
exact normalized integer significand and zero rational remainder. The
binary32 path does not pass through binary64. Nonzero results are normal finite values;
only `inexact` may be set. Overflow and tininess diagnostics remain false,
including when `i64::MAX` rounds to +2^63. No host FP, x87, CPU/MXCSR mutation,
or architectural exception delivery is involved; an i32 caller can sign-extend
through the i64 API.

Literal tests cover zero, ±1, every leading-bit position through the 2^63
magnitude of `i64::MIN`, i32 extrema, i64 extrema and adjacent values, and
boundaries around 2^24 and 2^53. Both signs and all four rounding modes are
checked for ties and directed rounding, with explicit value bits, inexact,
overflow, and tiny diagnostics; normal-class assertions cover every
leading-bit position. The focused conversion tests passed 2/2;
one literal proves binary32 rounds directly from i64: an integer just above a
binary32 midpoint rounds upward even though an intermediate binary64 would
round to the midpoint first. The complete `binary_float::tests` suite passed
72/72, `cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets
--offline`, and `git diff --check` passed. Independent Sol medium code and
documentation reviews found no remaining issues after the recommended
anti-double-rounding literal and accuracy edits were incorporated. Full S2-36
and S2-36w hardware/Mac mini acceptance remain open; instruction-level
integration and hardware execution are deferred to later work and the combined
final substage, respectively.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A `CVTSI2SD` §3-236–237 and `CVTSI2SS`
§3-238–239 specify signed integer-to-floating conversion, MXCSR rounding
control, and SIMD Precision exception behavior. The explicit-mode helper is
only a local mathematical conversion contract; it does not update MXCSR or
deliver that architectural exception. See [official Intel Vol. 2A PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199)
and the [S2-36w plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36w--bounded-signed-i64-to-binary32binary64-value-conversion).

## S2-36x — bounded raw binary32/binary64 to signed i32 conversion

`Binary32::to_i32(mode)` and `Binary64::to_i32(mode)` return the local
`BinaryIntegerResult` with converted value, inexactness, and
`invalid_operation`. Both use exact raw classification and finite
normalization, then integer-only quotient/remainder rounding. The implementation
handles magnitudes below one directly, rounds the finite integer/fraction split
for larger inputs, and checks the i32 range only after rounding. This preserves
the valid exact `i32::MIN` encoding and values slightly below it that round back
to the minimum under selected modes. Invalid conversions return the
`i32::MIN` sentinel with `inexact=false`. Neither helper changes its source or
CPU/MXCSR state, delivers exceptions, nor represents architectural sticky-flag
behavior or exception priority.

Literal tests cover both widths across all four modes: signed zeros and minimum
subnormals; values below, at, and above 0.5; ±1.5 and ±2.5; exact integers;
binary64 quarter/half/three-quarter cases around both signed range boundaries;
binary32 adjacent range encodings; huge finite values; both signed infinities;
and both signs of quiet and signaling NaNs. Tests verify source encodings remain
unchanged, valid results' inexactness, and invalid sentinel/inexact behavior.
The focused `raw_to_i32` suite passed 4/4 tests and the full
`binary_float::tests` suite passed 76/76. `cargo fmt --all -- --check`,
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, `git diff --check`, and
`graphify update .` also completed successfully.
`python3 tools/check_layout.py` remains blocked by the pre-existing open
[ISSUE-023](../KNOWN_ISSUES.md#issue-023--layout-checker-reports-worktree-metadata-and-stale-oracle-links):
it reports the `.git` worktree pointer as unmapped and the two archived Stage 1/2
oracle manifests as broken links. This task did not change layout.

Full S2-36 and Stage 2 acceptance remain open. This local conversion helper is
not instruction integration; SSE/MXCSR architectural exception delivery and
hardware/Mac mini comparison remain deferred to the combined final substage.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A `CVTSD2SI` p. 3-232, `CVTSS2SI` p. 3-242,
`CVTTSD2SI` p. 3-253, and `CVTTSS2SI` p. 3-255; Vol. 1 §4.9.2. The SDM defines the
architectural conversion and exception behavior; the helper deliberately
implements only the local contract above. See the [official Vol. 2A PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671199)
and [Vol. 1 PDF](https://cdrdv2-public.intel.com/835781/325462-sdm-vol-1-2abcd-3abcd-4.pdf),
and the [S2-36x plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36x--bounded-raw-binary32binary64-to-signed-i32-conversion).

## S2-36y — bounded raw binary32/binary64 to signed i64 conversion

Implemented `Binary32::to_i64(mode)` and `Binary64::to_i64(mode)` as pure
value conversions returning `BinaryIntegerResult<i64>`. The default generic
type remains `i32`, and the S2-36x methods retain their public signatures and
sentinel behavior. Both methods round the exact value before checking signed
range. Zero is exact; `-2^63` is valid; non-finite or out-of-range results use
the `i64::MIN` sentinel with `invalid_operation=true` and `inexact=false`.
Valid inexact conversions report their fractional loss. The source, CPU state,
and MXCSR are unchanged; exception delivery is outside this helper.

The former i32-specific split/halfway implementation is now a shared private
magnitude-rounding helper. It handles zero and exponents below zero directly,
uses the rational precision-rounding primitive for exponents 0 through 63,
and rejects larger exponents. Typed wrappers independently enforce their
destination limits and avoid negating signed minimum values.

Literal checks cover both source widths across all four modes, signed zeros,
fractional values, exponents 31/32, 52/53, 62/63/64, huge finite values, signed
infinities, and quiet/signaling NaNs. The range matrix uses actual adjacent
source encodings: binary32's positive predecessor is 2^63−2^39 and binary64's
is 2^63−1024. It verifies exact valid `-2^63`, invalid `+2^63` and adjacent
out-of-range values, local invalid/inexact suppression, and raw source
immutability. The existing i32 suite remains unchanged.

Focused `raw_to_i64` tests passed 3/3; all `binary_float::tests` passed 79/79,
including the unchanged S2-36x i32 tests. `cargo fmt --all -- --check`,
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, and `git diff --check`
completed successfully with no warnings or diff errors. `graphify update .`
completed with 7,953 nodes, 16,024 edges, and 255 communities. Its output noted
one syntax warning for the unrelated `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h`, 13
files without extracted symbols, and 48 unclassified metadata/unsupported
files. Independent Sol medium code and documentation reviews found no defects.
Full S2-36/Stage 2 acceptance and hardware/Mac mini checks remain open and
deferred to the combined final substage. See the
[S2-36y plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36y--bounded-raw-binary32binary64-to-signed-i64-conversion).

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2A `CVTSD2SI` p. 3-232,
`CVTSS2SI` p. 3-242, `CVTTSD2SI` p. 3-253, and `CVTTSS2SI` p. 3-255.
The architectural behavior is referenced for bounds only; no instruction,
MXCSR, sticky-flag or exception-delivery semantics are implemented here.

## S2-36z — pure raw binary32/binary64 SSE MIN/MAX selection

Added `Binary32::min_sse_raw_result`/`max_sse_raw_result` and matching
`Binary64` methods. The SSE-specific API names distinguish the legacy
right-operand selection semantics from IEEE minNumber/fmin operations. Each
returns `BinarySelectionResult<T>`, which contains only the selected raw value
and local `invalid_operation`; no rounding or denormal diagnostics are
fabricated.

Either quiet or signaling NaN selects the RHS encoding unchanged and reports
invalid, including RHS SNaN passthrough. For non-NaNs, MIN chooses the LHS only
when it is strictly less, MAX only when strictly greater, and all equal values
choose the RHS. This covers signed-zero ties and exact subnormal numeric order
through the existing raw comparator. Sources remain unchanged. MXCSR updates,
denormal-exception reporting, instruction dispatch, and architectural exception
delivery are outside this helper slice.

Literal tests cover strict ordering in both directions for both widths,
subnormal order and infinities, equal values, opposite-signed zero in both
operand orders, QNaNs and SNaNs in either position, distinct NaN payloads,
unchanged SNaN payload passthrough, invalid outcomes for every NaN class, NaN
noncommutativity, and source immutability. Passed:
`cargo test -p od-isa binary_float::tests::raw_binary32_min_max_selection_is_literal_and_nonmutating --offline`
(1/1),
`cargo test -p od-isa binary_float::tests::raw_binary64_min_max_selection_is_literal_and_nonmutating --offline`
(1/1), and `cargo test -p od-isa binary_float::tests:: --offline` (81/81).
The independent code re-review passed with no remaining findings.

`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
and `git diff --check` passed. The final `graphify update .` completed with
7,968 nodes, 16,067 edges, and 287 communities. Graphify retained its existing
warning for the unrelated `include/open_desktop/host_abi.h` parser error and listed
unsupported metadata files; it reported no new source syntax errors. No
physical-hardware or native/JIT run was performed.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 2B MAXSS/MAXSD and MINSS/MINSD operation
definitions and SIMD floating-point exception tables. [Official Intel Vol. 2B
PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241). See the
[S2-36z plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36z--pure-raw-binary32binary64-sse-minmax-selection).

## S2-36aa — pure raw same-format binary32/binary64 square root

Implemented `Binary32::sqrt_raw_result(mode)` and `Binary64::sqrt_raw_result(mode)`
as pure same-format value helpers. They preserve signed zero and positive
infinity; negative finite nonzero values and negative infinity return the
negative Intel indefinite QNaN with local invalid; QNaN is preserved and SNaN
is quieted by setting the quiet bit, with invalid only for SNaN. The NaN rule
is an explicit local sign/payload-preserving policy and is not claimed as an
exact payload mapping established by Intel Table 11-1. Finite positive inputs
are normalized and handled entirely with integer arithmetic before one call
to existing round-and-pack; the raw source is unchanged.

The restoring `u128` integer square-root helper yields `q=floor(sqrt(N))` for
full-width inputs. The normalized radicand uses Euclidean exponent splitting,
including negative odd exponents. The packer receives `0/1` for exact roots or
the documented rounding-equivalent representative `1/2` when the exact root
has a nonzero fractional tail. This representative is not the exact root
fraction; its correctness relies on binary32/binary64 precision and their 40/
11 discarded bits. Positive finite results remain normal and only inexactness
can be reported. No instruction dispatch, x87, packed lanes, MXCSR,
architectural exception delivery, denormal-operand reporting, DAZ/FTZ input
handling, native/JIT, or CPUID behavior is implemented. Subnormal inputs are
still consumed as exact raw finite values by this helper.

Literal tests cover sqrt(2) and sqrt(0.5) in every rounding mode for both
formats, exact roots, signed zeros, infinities, negative finite/infinity
invalid results, QNaN/SNaN policy, subnormal and normal source boundaries, and
raw-source immutability. The minimum binary64 subnormal has an exact root
(`2^-537`) and is asserted exact. Integer-root checks cover 0, 1, 2,
perfect-square neighbors, and `u128::MAX` with overflow-safe floor inequalities.
The focused `raw_sqrt` tests passed (2/2), the helper invariant test passed
(1/1), and the complete `binary_float::tests` set passed (84/84). Reproduce
with:

```sh
cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests::raw_sqrt
cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests::integer_square_root_has_overflow_safe_floor_invariant
cargo test -p od-isa --offline binary_float::tests
```

`cargo fmt --all -- --check`, `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`,
`git diff --check`, and `graphify update .` passed. Graphify reported the existing
`include/open_desktop/host_abi.h` parser warning and rebuilt the graph to 7,977
nodes, 16,105 edges, and 254 communities; no new source syntax errors were
reported. Independent code and docs reviews completed clean with no remaining
findings. No hardware or native/JIT run was performed.

Provenance: Intel SDM Rev. 093 Vol. 1 Table 11-1 identifies negative SQRT
inputs as invalid with QNaN indefinite response and refers SNaN handling to
Table D-10. This does not prove the exact NaN sign/payload mapping selected by
the local helper. Vol. 2B `SQRTSD` pp. 4-667–4-668 and `SQRTSS` pp. 4-669–4-670
list invalid, precision, and denormal exceptions; this slice does not report
denormal operands or apply DAZ/FTZ. [Official Intel Vol. 1 PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671436)
and [Vol. 2B PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671241). See the
[S2-36aa plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-36aa--pure-raw-same-format-binary32binary64-square-root).

## S2-27a — exact Long64 `LGDT [RBP-10]`

**Статус:** в процессе; локальные проверки реализации автора записаны ниже.
После уточнения GDTR field comment независимое Sol medium code review
завершено чисто; оставшихся замечаний нет. Mac mini/SSH проверки остаются в
общем финальном substage.

Целевой Ubuntu reference form — точные байты `0F 01 55 F6` (`LGDT m16&64
[RBP-10]`). Узкий local slice допускает только bare Long64 `0F 01 55 ib`
(`ib` signed disp8) при `state.gdtr == Some(_)`. CPL0 читает ровно 10-byte
pseudo-descriptor: little-endian 16-bit limit и 64-bit base. GDTR обновляется
атомарно после полного чтения и canonical48 проверки. Nonzero CPL и
noncanonical loaded base дают `#GP(0)`; RBP source-address failure даёт
`#SS(0)`. Fault оставляет старый GDTR; GDT по загруженному base не читается.
Privilege fault precedes data callbacks; success commits GDTR, advances RIP by
4, and retires once. Fault does not commit or retire. Exact LOCK is `#UD` with
existing fetch priority; other prefixes are `Unsupported`. LIDT, other
operand/addressing forms, GDT target reads, descriptor validation, and cache
reload are outside the slice. These are target contract details, not claims
about Linux execution. This is a static reference candidate, not a Linux boot
claim. Its package/source/binary evidence is recorded separately in the
[Linux profile report](STAGE_2_LINUX_PROFILE.md#s2-27a--exact-ubuntu-lgdt-candidate).

**Локальные проверки автора:** `cargo test -p od-isa --offline lgdt_` (11
passed); `cargo test -p od-isa --offline verw_` (8 passed);
`cargo check -p od-isa --all-targets --offline`;
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `git diff --check`; `graphify update .`.
Независимое Sol medium code review завершено чисто после уточнения GDTR field
comment; оставшихся замечаний нет. Mac mini/SSH проверки, physical/native
execution и Linux boot не выполнялись и не заявляются.

Нормативные и source references: [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-27a--exact-long64-lgdt-rbp-10),

## S2-27e — entry-only maskable-interrupt eligibility notification

**Статус:** implementation and focused tests passed; independent Sol medium
code review completed clean; no findings remain.
`run_with_maskable_request` is an optional local API over a
caller-owned immutable `Option<u8>` vector. At a caller-confirmed fresh
completed-instruction boundary with no pending synchronous exception, debug
event, or inhibition, it may return a distinct pre-fetch eligibility result
when IF=1, after `stop_rip` → exactly one
`stop_requested` poll → budget precedence. It does not mutate or acknowledge
the vector, CPU, memory, IF, or retirement. With IF clear or no request it
delegates directly to the existing event-free run path without interrupt
request polling; existing run APIs are unchanged. A prior `Fault` is not
evidence for interrupt delivery.

The API reads concrete IF from `state.rflags`; `rflags_defined` tracks
`INTEGER_FLAGS` and does not include IF. It does not infer IF validity from that
mask and preserves the caller's definedness mask. The caller must supply a
concrete IF bit. For an eligible request, entry TF/RF/VM bits produce
`IncompatibleEntryFlags` before host-exit checks.

**Авторские проверки:** `cargo test -p od-isa --offline maskable_request_`
(5/5); `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`;
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `git diff --check`; and `graphify update .`
passed. There is no APIC/IDT/gate/stack handling, event delivery, asynchronous
arrival, MOV SS shadow, REP partial-event claim, or generic event framework.
No boot or physical execution claim is made. See the
[CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-27e--entry-only-maskable-interrupt-eligibility-notification)
and [Stage 2 plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-27e--entry-only-maskable-interrupt-eligibility-notification).

## S2-27f — bounded caller-selected Long64 maskable interrupt delivery

**Статус:** implementation and focused tests are present. Initial independent
Sol review findings for IDT gate S=1 and current CS-cache validation were
fixed; final Sol medium re-review completed clean, with no findings remaining. Architecture review is
**approve/narrow** for this synchronous, explicit local API against Intel SDM
Vol. 3A Rev. 093 (September 2026), §§7.12.1.2–3 and 7.14
([official Intel PDF](https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/developer/articles/technical/intel-sdm.html)). The
reviewed scope is one caller-selected external maskable vector delivered into
a private Long64 CPL0 state; this is not automatic event integration with the
run loop, an APIC, or a queue.

`deliver_maskable_interrupt` requires the caller to certify a fresh completed-
instruction boundary, no pending synchronous exception/debug/NMI event or
interrupt inhibition, private synchronous RAM, and disabled CET, VMX, SMM, and
shadow stacks. Its access context must be Long64 Ring 0; IF must be set, and
entry TF/RF/VM/NT are rejected. The supplied `rflags_defined` must be a subset
of `INTEGER_FLAGS`. The current CS selector must be non-null with RPL 0; its
cache must describe present, non-conforming ring-0 Long64 code with S=1,
executable, base 0, limit `u32::MAX`, L=1, and D=0. The cache is validated
without reloading the current descriptor from the GDT; its accessed bit is not
checked. A current SS selector with RPL 0 is required; `Some(0)` is admitted,
and its cache may be absent. Existing SS selector/cache state is preserved.
IDTR and GDTR must be present.

The operation reads the selected 16-byte IDT gate and its target 8-byte GDT
code descriptor after table-bound and canonical-span checks. The gate is a
present 64-bit interrupt gate with IST=0, S=0, and zero reserved upper bytes.
Gate DPL is ignored for this caller-selected external vector. The target code
descriptor must be present, accessed, non-conforming ring-0 code with L=1 and
D=0; its selector must name the GDT and target RIP must be canonical. The
implementation rejects LDT selectors and gate types other than 0xE. It does
not implement IST, privilege transitions, or code-limit enforcement.

The operation writes exactly five qwords: old SS, RSP, RFLAGS, CS, and RIP at
successive descending addresses from the old RSP aligned down to 16 bytes. The
new RSP is aligned old RSP minus 40; from new RSP upward, memory contains RIP,
CS, RFLAGS, RSP, SS. It commits CPU state only after all five stack stores
succeed, then loads target CS/RIP and clears IF/TF/VM/RF/NT. If a store fails,
earlier writes may remain in guest memory even though CPU state is unchanged;
the caller must stop and must not retry. There is no instruction fetch,
retirement, APIC acknowledgement, interrupt request queue, or event loop
integration.

**Авторские проверки:** `cargo test -p od-isa interrupt::tests --offline`
(10/10); fragment-adapter CS/SS rejection (1/1); integer-snapshot CS/SS
rejection (1/1); `cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`;
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `git diff --check`; and `graphify update .`.
The interrupt tests cover eight old-RSP alignment offsets and exact frame
bytes, DPL/RPL behavior for vectors 2 and 14, gate S/type/present/IST/reserved
rejection, null/TI selector rejection, current CS selector/cache coherence,
GDT bounds, stack underflow/noncanonicality, all five injected stack-store
failures, descriptor/read failures, IDT bounds/canonical spans, and zero
instruction fetches. These direct unit tests do not integrate page tables or
the run loop and do not establish native/physical behavior. No Linux boot,
event-delivery integration, Mac mini, or SSH check is claimed. See the
[CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#s2-27f--bounded-caller-selected-long64-maskable-interrupt-delivery)
and [Stage 2 plan](../plans/STAGE_2.md#s2-27f--bounded-caller-selected-long64-maskable-interrupt-delivery).

## S2-26e — точный RDTSC с явным TSC-источником

Implemented exact bare Long64 RDTSC (`0F 31`) under explicit
`s2-long-rdtsc-v1`. The interpreter receives immutable CR4.TSD controls and an
injected 64-bit source; CPL comes from the existing access context. CR4.TSD at
CPL1–3 returns CPU-side `#GP(0)` after fetch with zero retirement, no state
change and no source read. Otherwise one source call supplies zero-extended
EAX=low32 and EDX=high32, advances RIP by two, and preserves all remaining
state and memory. The legacy interpreter API is Unsupported; fixtures record
the configured value and expected call count, while result snapshots expose
the observed call count. Generic amd64 and CPUID masks are unchanged. JIT,
native admission remains closed; the C ABI fragment-creation path rejects the
opcode because it has no profile/source inputs. No host clock or guest
exception delivery is modeled.

CR4.TSD ring-3 `#GP(0)` with zero calls. Core tests cover CR4.TSD on/off at
CPL0–3, exact writes and preservation, legacy Unsupported, prefixes, truncated
fetch, stop and zero-budget ordering. The runner verifies source-call evidence
and denies JIT/native.

`step_with_msr_profile` / `run_with_msr_profile`. Они принимают только bare
Long64 `RDMSR` (`0F 32`) и `WRMSR` (`0F 30`) с индексом `ECX[31:0]` ровно
`0x174..0x176`; верх RCX игнорируется. Для этих индексов обе формы возвращают
CPU-side `#GP(0)` при CPL0 и CPL1–3; неизвестные индексы и legacy/CPUID-only
API остаются `Unsupported`. Fault не меняет state, не вызывает data-memory
callbacks и не retire-ит инструкцию. Exact LOCK формы дают `#UD` после fetch;
прочие prefix forms остаются `Unsupported` с приоритетом fetch truncation.

**Локальные проверки:** `cargo check -p od-isa --all-targets --offline`;
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline sysenter_msr_` (3 passed);
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline cpuid_` (3 passed);
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline diagnostic_v1_returns` (1 passed);
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `git diff --check`; `graphify update .`.
MSR tests покрывают RDMSR/WRMSR × три выбранных индекса × CPL0–3, high RCX
bits с low32 в allowlist, неразрешённые индексы, отказ legacy и CPUID-only API,
LOCK/other prefix, точную последовательность успешных и неуспешных fetches,
STOP/zero budget до fetch, `#GP(0)` без retirement и отсутствие data callbacks.
CPUID regression tests подтверждают, что `DiagnosticV1` сохранил нулевые
feature masks и прежнее profile-gated поведение.

**Независимое code review:** повторное Sol medium review чистое после двух
исправлений тестов: negative RCX vector теперь имеет low32 вне allowlist, а
усечённый LOCK фиксирует попытку fetch недостающего третьего байта.

Этот срез исполняет только CPU-side fault decision выбранной synthetic target
policy. Он не утверждает доставку guest `#GP`, Linux safe-write fixup/`-EIO`,
общее поведение x86 MSR или загрузку Ubuntu/Linux. Успешные MSR read/write,
JIT/native/physical admission не реализованы и не проверялись; Mac mini/SSH
проверки остаются для общего финального substage. S2-26 и этап 2 остаются
открытыми.

## S2-26a — локальный `DiagnosticV1` CPUID

Добавлен immutable `CpuidProfile::DiagnosticV1` в `od-isa::cpuid`; API
`step_with_cpuid_profile` и `run_with_cpuid_profile` требуют явный выбор этого
profile. Legacy `step`, `run`, tracked execution и fixture path сохраняют
fail-closed поведение CPUID. Interpreter поддерживает только bare Long64
`0F A2`; точный `F0 0F A2` возвращает #UD, прочие prefix-bearing формы
`Unsupported`. Результаты CPUID zero-extend из u32 в GPR64, сохраняют flags и
остальное состояние, увеличивают RIP на 2 и не обращаются к data-memory
callbacks. Профиль не рекламирует feature bits; подробная таблица ответов
закреплена в [CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#локальный-cpuid-профиль-diagnosticv1-s2-26a).

**Локальные проверки:** `cargo check -p od-isa --all-targets --offline`;
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline cpuid_` (3 passed);
`cargo test -p od-isa --offline diagnostic_v1_returns` (1 passed);
`cargo fmt --all -- --check`; `git diff --check`. Graphify code graph обновлён.
Исполняемая матрица проверяет tuple table для всех заданных leaves и ECX
0/1/MAX, high input halves, zero-extension результата, flags/unrelated
register preservation, unsupported prefixes, exact LOCK/fetch fault, STOP,
budget, одну retirement, отсутствие data callbacks и отказ legacy API. Для
zero-budget и stop-at-current-RIP тестовая память отдельно считает code fetch
и подтверждает, что ни одного fetch callback не было.

**Независимое review:** завершено. JIT/native/physical execution не
допущены и не запускались; Mac mini regressions объединены в финальный
substage. `DiagnosticV1` не является x86-64-v1 CPU или Ubuntu/Linux boot
contract. S2-26 и этап 2 остаются открытыми.

## S2-00 — уточнение целевого Linux floor

Пользователь уточнил целевой профиль Ubuntu как Generic `amd64`. Для ABI/ISA
floor принята нормативная интерпретация x86-64 psABI baseline (x86-64-v1);
x86-64-v2/v3/v4 не входят в цель. Это не является принятием полного
CPU/CPUID/MSR/OS boot profile. После exact-image source/binary analysis выбран
synthetic reference CPU target `od-x86-64-v1-neutral-v0.1`, описанный в
[CPU contract](../specs/CPU_CONTRACT.md#ubuntu-generic-amd64-od-x86-64-v1-neutral-v01).
Это спецификация, а не реализация или подтверждение загрузки. Полный MSR
allowlist, initial state и runtime branch manifest ещё открыты.

Доказательства разделены на нормативный floor, kernel config requirements,
upstream source reachability, exact Ubuntu source/binary и observed execution.
Статические config/source/package findings не подтверждают загрузку. Initramfs,
command line, device/topology manifest и success milestone не определены;
Linux boot и C/D/System остаются открытыми. На 28 октября подписанная
`resolute-updates` snapshot chain аутентифицировала kernel/buildinfo,
исторический metapackage и exact source package; exact direct64, main-kernel
`startup_64`/`verify_cpu`, FPU и CPUID paths сопоставлены с байтами образа и
source lines. The main kernel reaches `verify_cpu` after the direct64 prefix;
compressed 32-bit startup's separate call is bypassed. Vendor-specific early
branches informed selection of the synthetic reference target now recorded in
the CPU contract; its runtime implementation and complete MSR/entry manifest
remain open.
Runtime choice of alternatives, PE signature, frozen CPU/machine manifest and
guest boot remain unchecked. Подробности
и ограничения:
[S2-00 Linux profile report](STAGE_2_LINUX_PROFILE.md#решение-по-generic-amd64-baseline).

## S2-22e — CPL3 GDT-only VERW

Added the local-only `s2-long-verw-gdt-v1` profile and one exact decoder form,
bare `0F 00 E8` (`VERW AX`). GDTR base/limit are explicit, validated and
compared state. The interpreter performs null/TI/table-bound checks, reads one
complete 8-byte descriptor through descriptor-table access origin, and updates
only ZF based on writable-data type and CPL/RPL/DPL rights. It does not write
the descriptor or check present. A descriptor-table access retains CPL3 for
rights checks while using supervisor page privilege. Memory faults propagate
with no instruction commit or retirement. Native admission fails closed.

Eight literal fixtures cover writable, read-only, code, system, privilege
mismatch, exact-fit and short table limits, null selector, and RPL0 success.
The runner asserts full GPR preservation, RIP+3, one retirement, ZF, GDTR and
unchanged descriptor bytes. Unit tests additionally cover one exact 8-byte
read and context, no-read selector cases, no-commit backend/page faults,
profile required/null/width/canonical validation, legacy adapter rejection,
decoder neighbors/truncation and native admission guards.

Verification passed: `cargo test --workspace --offline` (344 tests),
`cargo check --workspace --all-targets --offline`, Python CPU suite and all
generator freshness tests (83 tests), the targeted VERW generator tests (2),
and `python3 tools/check_layout.py`. Linux x86_64 `cargo check --workspace
--all-targets --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --offline` also passed as a
compile-only check; it emitted existing dead-code warnings in `od-host` and
`od-runner`. `cargo fmt --all -- --check` and `git diff --check` passed. No
physical/native execution was performed; Linux-gated native tests were not
executed on macOS. Independent Sol-medium review found and then verified a fix
for VERW ZF-definedness metadata; the re-review reported no remaining findings.
This slice does not complete S2-22 or S2-27.

Normative sources: Intel SDM revision 093, Vol.2C (326018-093US),
“VERR/VERW—Verify a Segment for Reading or Writing,” pp.5-162–5-163,
[official PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671072); Vol.3A
(325384-093US), §§3.5.1, 6.10.2, and 6.11.5,
[official combined PDF](https://cdrdv2.intel.com/v1/dl/getContent/671447).

```sh
python3 tests/cpu/generate_stage2_verw_gdt.py --check
python3 tests/cpu/test_stage2_verw_gdt_generator.py
```
